description: Writing and leaving code, the jobs done on it and committing it; not rbtv instruction files, which the framework in core/rbtv owns. The coding skill carries the four disciplines (no dead code, no duplicate source, no monolith, no patches) and the ladder, and routes to building a command-line interface, improving a codebase's architecture, reviewing for over-engineering and the shortcut ledger; the rbtv-commit tool commits a chosen set of files, and cli-preview renders a CLI output review to one offline page.
